monitor.testsDisabled: Unavailable while the simulator is running

confirmTestClose.title: Close this profile's apps?
confirmTestClose.description: No test launch was run for this profile. Every running app in the profile will be closed according to its own rule.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.description: The profile and all its items will be removed. This cannot be undone.

items.emptyDescription: Add the apps and websites that should open with the simulator.

itemForm.name: Name
itemForm.workingDirHint: Optional. Defaults to the executable's folder.
itemForm.processNameHint: Used to detect and close the app. Change it if the executable is only a launcher.

validation.name: Enter a name with 1 to 80 characters
validation.url: Enter an http or https URL
validation.timeout: Use a value between 1000 and 60000 ms

errors.io: Could not read or write a file
errors.lastProfile: At least one profile must remain
errors.processNotDetected: The process was not detected after launch
errors.accessDenied: Access denied: run AutoStart as administrator
errors.closeTimedOut: The app did not close in time
errors.autostart: Could not update the Windows startup entry

elevation.title: Some apps may not be closed
elevation.description: Profile "{{profile}}" has apps that run as administrator. Unless AutoStart is elevated, Windows prevents closing them. Apps launched by an elevated AutoStart also inherit elevation.
elevation.relaunchCancelled: Elevation cancelled. AutoStart keeps running without administrator rights.

logs.title: Logs
logs.emptyDescription: When the simulator starts, or when you use the test buttons, the timeline shows up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Opens AutoStart when you sign in to Windows, without administrator rights.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Shows only the tray icon, without opening the window.
settings.gracefulTimeoutHint: After this delay, apps that did not close are force closed.
settings.closeOnlyIfLaunchedByAppHint: Apps that were already open before the simulator stay open.
settings.checkUpdatesOnStartupHint: Looks for a new version every time AutoStart opens.

trigger.title: Welcome to AutoStart
trigger.description: AutoStart watches your simulator process (the trigger). When it starts, your helper apps open in the order you choose; when it exits, they are closed.

simulator.title: Which simulator do you use?
simulator.description: We will set up the example profile with the right trigger. You can change it later.

items.title: Add your apps
items.description: On the main screen, use "Add app" to pick an executable or "Add URL" to open a website. Drag the cards to set the order and use the test buttons to check without opening the simulator.

startup.title: Make it automatic
startup.description: With AutoStart starting with Windows, just open the simulator. It stays quietly in the system tray.

updates.upToDate: You are already on the latest version
updates.installFailed: The update failed and was cancelled
